about: Neutral shared vectors for BUZZ_AGENT_GATEWAY version 2. The TypeScript and native validators must accept every valid case with these normalized outputs, treat every off case as routing off, and refuse every invalid case with exactly its error code. raw is the literal input; otherwise descriptor is JSON-encoded. Names are folded (ASCII lowercase, _ to -) before comparison with protected.

valid.name: no reserved prefixes and no upstreams
a codex upstream, which native doesn't forward

invalid.name: over 8 KiB in UTF-8 bytes, not characters
a version 2 descriptor with an extra legacy key
an upstream base that is a URL
an upstream base with a trailing slash
protected and duplicate: protected is checked first
a codex upstream base with a dot segment
a codex upstream with an extra key
unknown upstream and bad base: shape is checked first
